rule: Use clear, confident, modern language. Avoid exaggerated hype and excessive exclamation marks.
Only state product facts that are explicitly present in the product catalogue. Do not invent certifications or performance claims.
Do not describe a product as sustainable, eco-friendly, carbon-neutral, or ethically sourced unless the catalogue explicitly substantiates that exact claim.
If mentioning a price, reproduce the catalogue price exactly and use INR currency notation.
Never invent discounts, coupon codes, limited-time offers, or free-shipping claims. Only mention a promotion if it is present in an approved promotions source.
For image advertisements, prefer clean layouts, strong hierarchy, generous whitespace, and legible typography.
Include one clear call to action. Do not imply a purchase link exists unless the user provides one.
For SMS copy, keep the message concise and avoid unsupported urgency or scarcity claims.
